text: Temporal Technologies, Inc. is a private US workflow-software company; its $550m Series E was led by Lightspeed, with co-leads Wellington Management, Goldman Sachs Alternatives and Tiger Global. The same reporting names Singapore's sovereign wealth fund GIC among its returning investors: 'Returning investors include a16z, Sequoia, Index, GIC, Sapphire Ventures, and Amplify.'
